_comment: objnam.c an() reports an empty name through pline.c impossible(). A debug-mode dwarvish Valkyrie reaches experience level 12, puts on a blessed amulet of life saving, lets a hostile ice vortex engulf her, wishes lava under herself, and sets a short Sick timeout with #wizintrinsic. The illness kills her inside the vortex: end.c done() uses up the amulet, savelife() expels her into the lava, where her small shield burns, and the nested done(BURNING) asks 'Die?'; n keeps her alive and clears svk.killer.name (end.c 1120). The outer done() then calls topten.c formatkiller(), whose KILLED_BY_AN branch calls an(""): 'Alphabet soup: 'an("")'.', 'Program in disorder!  (Saving and reloading may fix this problem.)' and 'Please report these messages to devteam@nethack.org.' print before 'You survived that attempt on your life.', with timeout.c done_timeout()'s FoodPois still on the status line. The seed, clock, character, engulfer and inputs were chosen for this path.
